status: READINESS ONLY. Implemented and statically tested; NOT executed. No fit, no rollout, no environment, no critic, no PPO, no new collection, no candidate actor, no j19a_runs, no sealed seed, no valid architect GO.

phase_separation.rule: fit and rollout are NEVER chained in one execution; every phase closes with a report and an audit
phase_separation.J19A: single refit of the selected candidate, reproducibility check, offline eligibility, commit of ONE actor into ONE leaf. This document.
phase_separation.J19B: binding closed-loop A-F. DESCRIBED ONLY. Not executable, not started, not preregistered here. It will be preregistered and pinned ONLY after the architect audits the J19A leaf.

architect_decisions_encoded.decision: G1/G2 max-drift 0.005 remain DIAGNOSTIC, never binding

G3/G4 no longer use 0.0014557. The binding ceiling is J8's own absolute empirical bias, computed at full precision on the same C/D blocks against the same parent J2. Criterion: not-worse-than-operational-J8, not derived from any sigma.
E-C/E-D remain binding at J8's exact RMSE values
POST-485 is computed and recorded as a NON-BINDING diagnostic
max-drift may remain the third ranking key as a DIAGNOSTIC tie-break among already-eligible candidates only; it is currently irrelevant because exactly one candidate is eligible

reproducibility: best_epoch exactly 191; steps/batches/seed/config/dataset/provenance exact; the six frozen metrics compared with math.isclose(rel_tol=1e-06, abs_tol=1e-09). This is NUMERICAL tolerance, not a performance gate. On failure: fail-closed, no actor, no rollout.
closed-loop A-F (J19B) uses exclusively 20 mm soft diagnostic, 25 mm July diagnostic, > 28 mm sole hard binding (exactly 28 passes), and every other frozen criterion of the J9R1 matrix

selected_configuration.source: the J18 leaf, frozen; this stage selects nothing and re-ranks nothing
selected_configuration.sealed_seeds_126_127_128: not read, not generated, not used

training_code_provenance.rule: J19A imports the FROZEN J18 runner and reuses its training path unmodified.
training_code_provenance.why_this_inverts_the_J18_hermeticity_rul: J18 was required to import no prior-stage executable module, because its behaviour had to be fully determined by the seven artefacts its GO pinned. J19A's purpose is the opposite: to REPRODUCE a J18 result. Re-transcribing the training loop would make any mismatch ambiguous - a genuine irreproducibility and a transcription error would be indistinguishable. Importing the pinned original is therefore the requirement, not a violation.

the_six_frozen_metrics.note: READ from the pinned leaf at run time, never hardcoded in the runner. Reproduced here for the audit.

reproducibility_contract.a_BETTER_result_also_fails: yes, by construction: this is a reproduction check, not a performance gate

exact_field_comparison.rule: every field below is compared for EXACT equality, recorded field by field in the result and in the receipt, and is fail-closed. It is NOT left to an implicit reliance on the preflight.
exact_field_comparison.reference: the frozen J18 leaf and the pinned J18 dataset manifest

label_hash_policy.blocks_whose_labels_are_read_from_a_file: A, B and C - exact hash required, and that was already J18's contract
label_hash_policy.block_D_whose_labels_are_computed: exact hash required in THIS reproduction
label_hash_policy.historical_distinction_preserved: J18's contract was CROSS-PLATFORM and therefore bound block D's computed labels by a 1e-06 TOLERANCE rather than by hash, because a BLAS difference can move the last bits. J19A is a SAME-PLATFORM reproduction, so the exact hash is required and a mismatch means the computation changed, not that the platform did. The distinction is recorded as a note on the labels_sha256.D field itself.

reproducibility_contract.on_failure: FAIL-CLOSED. No actor is written, no rollout is authorised, the leaf records the divergence field by field, and the phase returns to the architect. No retry, no tolerance widening.

binding.name: preservation_bias_D
binding.origin: MEASURED: J8's own absolute empirical bias vs J2 on block D, max over the two actions

binding.name: preservation_rmse_C
binding.origin: MEASURED: J8's own RMSE drift vs J2 on block C

binding.name: preservation_rmse_D
binding.origin: MEASURED: J8's own RMSE drift vs J2 on block D

binding.name: finiteness
binding.origin: structural, unchanged; recursive over state, metrics and every reported diagnostic

diagnostic_only_never_binding.name: drift on the 485 post-mismatch rows of cell B
diagnostic_only_never_binding.why_diagnostic: these rows are the TARGET REGION of the correction. A corrected actor is supposed to change there, so a large value is not per se bad and any association with closed-loop failure is confounded by design.

offline_eligibility.the_J8_ceilings_are_recomputed_at_run_ti: the runner recomputes J8's bias and RMSE drift vs J2 on the same blocks and asserts they match the values above. They are derived, then checked, never merely trusted.

G11_coverage.rule: G11's recursive finiteness covers the actor state and the A-D block metrics, which are passed separately, PLUS one single explicit payload carrying EVERY other numeric family the result publishes. No published number sits outside it.
g11_payload_families: training_diagnostics (best_epoch, best_objective, optimizer_steps, batches_per_epoch, scale_absorption, post_485_diagnostic, history)
G11_coverage.why_one_explicit_payload: reproducibility and the exact-field comparison are computed BEFORE eligibility, so both can be included. Passing only the training diagnostics would leave candidate, j8_ceilings, raw_vs_scaled_equivalence, reproducibility and exact_fields published but unchecked.
G11_coverage.evaluate_eligibility_refuses_a_missing_f: yes: it raises, naming the missing families, rather than silently gating less

publication_rule.rule: the result publishes ONLY sanitised values. The whole g11_payload is sanitised in one pass and each family is taken from the SAFE copy.
publication_rule.history_json: built from the SANITISED history inside the safe payload, never from the raw training output
publication_rule.receipt: carries only derived booleans, counters, lists of field names and hash strings; no raw float can reach it even in principle

promotion_is_impossible_when_any_non_fin.rule: if sanitisation reports ANY finding anywhere in the published record, the actor is not promoted, whatever the gates said
promotion_is_impossible_when_any_non_fin.the_record_is_still_written: sanitised, with each finding's path and kind, so the evidence survives
promotion_is_impossible_when_any_non_fin.no_NaN_ever_reaches_JSON: encode_json uses allow_nan=False as the last barrier

offline_eligibility.on_failure: FAIL-CLOSED. No actor is written and no rollout is authorised.

actor_persistence.condition: written ONLY after the reproducibility contract AND every binding eligibility criterion have passed
actor_persistence.born_invalid_marker: TECHNICAL_INVALID written into staging FIRST, removed only as the LAST write after post-commit verification succeeds
actor_persistence.post_commit_verification: every leaf-relative path is re-resolved from the COMMITTED receipt, re-hashed, and compared both to the receipt and to the staged bytes
actor_persistence.actor_manifest_must_be_truthful: its own module_state_sha256, its own actor_digest, its own label; the stale J8 sidecar is never read as an identity source

what_this_stage_can_and_cannot_establish.can: that the selected J18 result reproduces exactly, and that the reproduced actor satisfies every binding offline criterion derived from the operational actor J8.
what_this_stage_can_and_cannot_establish.cannot: anything about closed-loop behaviour. J17 measured that offline improvement does not certify closed-loop, and the J18 diagnosis measured the converse: the actor with the LOWEST drift of all, J4 at 0.00191, still incurred a 25 mm diagnostic breach. The binding verdict is J19B, which this stage does not perform and does not preauthorise.
